# Chiltern Timber

> Chiltern Timber is a UK timber and building materials supplier offering trade prices, delivery services, and a comprehensive range of hardwoods, softwoods, sheet materials, and garden products.

Based in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire, Chiltern Timber specializes in supplying timber merchants, contractors, and trade customers with FSC/PEFC certified products including structural timber, decorative mouldings, sheet materials, and garden landscaping supplies with nationwide UK delivery.

## Key Topics

- Timber Products
- Hardwoods
- Softwoods
- Sheet Materials
- MDF
- Plywood
- Garden Landscaping
- Decking
- Fencing
- Mouldings
- Trade Prices
- Delivery Service
- Building Materials
- FSC/PEFC Certification
- Hemel Hempstead

## Core Product Categories

- [Timber](https://www.chilterntimber.co.uk/timber): Timber products catalog with hardwoods, softwoods and structural materials
- [Sheet Materials](https://www.chilterntimber.co.uk/sheet-materials): Sheet materials including plywood, MDF, veneers and worktops
- [Garden & Landscaping](https://www.chilterntimber.co.uk/garden-landscaping): Garden & landscaping products including decking, fencing and hardwood materials
- [Mouldings](https://www.chilterntimber.co.uk/mouldings): Mouldings catalog featuring skirting, architraves, cornice and decorative trim
- [Plumbing](https://www.chilterntimber.co.uk/plumbing): Plumbing supplies and building materials product category
